items.text: Amending the Transportation Code, Division II, Section 801 to expand parking restrictions along 24th Avenue and add pre-existing parking restrictions on Eddy and Jones Streets and approving the parking restriction to extend the SFPD vehicle only parking zone fronting Taraval Police Station along 24th Avenue as follows: 5 A. ESTABLISH – NO PARKING, ALL TIMES, EXCEPT CITY-OWNED SAN FRANCISCO POLICE DEPARTMENT VEHICLES DISPLAYING A PERMIT ISSUED BY THE SFMTA – 24th Avenue, east side, from 205 feet to 371 feet south of Santiago Street. (Explanatory documents include a staff report, amendment and resolution. The proposed action is the Approval Action as defined by the S.F. Administrative Code Chapter 31. RESOLUTION 190402-036 No public comment.
